resources.string: Keep local copies of downloaded files for one day, one week, or forever. Expired files are shown for review before you confirm cleanup. Cloud messages and exported copies are not deleted.

Tap a file for actions or to change its retention period. A per-file period starts when you set it. The all-files policy starts at each file’s download time. Duplicate-file cleanup remains available separately.
